sources.title: Kuwait Visa: live visa-on-arrival nationality dataset
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, State of Kuwait
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Kuwait Visa front end served from the Ministry of Interior domain calls this first-party endpoint; fresh sessions returned a successful 53-record dataset.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: encrypted country-list eligibility flow
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, State of Kuwait
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry of Interior front-end bundle configures this endpoint and RSA-encrypts a visaTypeId request before posting it.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: current tourist-visa instructions dataset
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, State of Kuwait
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Interior Kuwait Visa application serves this no-cache English instruction dataset.

unresolved.reason: Fresh Ministry of Interior sessions returned the same 53-entry visa-on-arrival dataset, but the current encrypted countryList flow supplied broad product collections by visaTypeId rather than a positive controlling tourist-nationality decision for this ordinary passport. No eVisa, visa-on-arrival, or advance-visa baseline is established; GCC residence, profession, US/UK/Schengen document, sponsor and other conditional routes are excluded.
